Keisen has no release yet, and this page documents only what exists in the source.

Nothing is listed below because no public function has shipped.
A page that describes an API before it exists is worse than an empty one: it reads as a promise, and the first reader to try it finds a compile error.

## What lands first

The first milestone adds the entry point and the numeric formatters:

- `display-table`, which folds directives into a table.
- `table-header` and `table-source-note`.
- `columns-label` and `columns-hide`.
- `format`, `format-number`, and `format-integer`.

Each one is documented here, with its arguments and defaults, in the same change that implements it.

Until then, the [issue tracker](https://github.com/{{< var repository.slug >}}/issues) carries the milestone breakdown, and [`ARCHITECTURE.md`](https://github.com/{{< var repository.slug >}}/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md) describes how the pipeline fits together.
